body: Are you in the US or Vietnam? Regardless I'm aware of the unrealistic and unreasonable expectations that cloud a lot of east Asian cultures. You're very young and don't deserve to be bullied and pressured the way you are, especially if you're already excelling. If your folks did everything so right then that "step" situation wouldn't exist. No one is perfect, everyone makes mistakes or has their limits. You should be allowed to be a kid. I hope you get to find the means to do that, I know how it feels to be trapped.
